channel.title: HarperCollins Christian Publishing - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from HarperCollins Christian Publishing (harpercollinschristian.com)

item.title: Bestselling Author Christine Caine’s New Book Launches, Inspiring Readers to Flourish in Faith and Resilience Amid Life’s Turmoil - HarperCollins Christian Publishing
item.description: Bestselling author and Bible teacher Christine Caine releases The Faith to Flourish, a powerful new book offering practical guidance and biblical wisdom for building a rooted, resilient, and fruitful life. Drawing on the symbolism of the olive tree, Caine helps readers move from spiritual stagnation to vibrant growth—even in life’s most challenging seasons.

item.title: Nelson Books Celebrates the Release of Kendall Mariah’s Debut Book, THIS LITTLE FIRE OF MINE - HarperCollins Christian Publishing
item.description: Debut author Kendall Mariah releases THIS LITTLE FIRE OF MINE, a raw and compelling invitation to wrestle honestly with doubt, deconstruction, and the messy middle of faith. Through vulnerable storytelling and practical tools for spiritual inventory, Mariah guides readers toward an authentic, resilient, and deeply personal faith—one forged in honesty rather than performance.

item.title: HarperCollins Christian Publishing Titles Recognized as Outreach Resources of the Year - HarperCollins Christian Publishing
item.description: HarperCollins Christian Publishing announces that five of its titles have been named Outreach Magazine’s 2026 Resources of the Year, with an additional book recognized as a recommended resource across categories including apologetics, evangelism, kids, social issues, and spiritual growth.

item.title: Tommy Nelson Announces New Fiction Series from Global Entertainment Stars Dude Perfect - HarperCollins Christian Publishing
item.description: Tommy Nelson announces Operation Trick Shot, the first book in the new middle grade Dude Perfect + Panda series, releasing May 12, 2026. Packed with sports, mystery, humor, and teamwork, the series brings the Dude Perfect crew to middle school for all‑new adventures.

item.title: Nelson Books Announces the Release of Jennie Allen’s New Book, THE LIE YOU DON’T KNOW YOU BELIEVE - HarperCollins Christian Publishing
item.description: Jennie Allen’s new book The Lie You Don’t Know You Believe invites readers to confront the unseen falsehoods shaping their thoughts, relationships, and sense of worth.

item.title: Thomas Nelson Teams Up With Movieguide Awards to Celebrate Family-Friendly Entertainment - HarperCollins Christian Publishing
item.description: Thomas Nelson Bibles continues its multi‑year sponsorship with the Movieguide Awards, celebrating faith‑based and family‑friendly entertainment at the 33rd annual gala filmed in Los Angeles and airing nationwide.

item.title: Thomas Nelson Bibles Partners with Hope Media Group to Enhance Spiritual Engagement - HarperCollins Christian Publishing
item.description: Hope Media Group (HMG) and Thomas Nelson Bibles have formed a multi-year agreement that will result in more people engaging with the life-changing message of the Bible.

item.title: Tim Tebow’s “If the Tree Could Speak” Becomes an Instant New York Times Bestseller, Debuting at #6 - HarperCollins Christian Publishing
item.description: Tim Tebow’s new book If the Tree Could Speak debuts at #6 on the New York Times Bestseller List. Published by Thomas Nelson Gift, the illustrated title offers a unique perspective on the crucifixion story and continues Tebow’s mission of sharing faith, hope, and redemption.

item.title: Jennie Allen’s Latest Book, THE LIE YOU DON’T KNOW YOU BELIEVE, Debuts at No. 7 on the New York Times Best Seller List - HarperCollins Christian Publishing
item.description: Jennie Allen’s transformative new book, The Lie You Don’t Know You Believe: How to Find It, Fight It, and Live Free, debuted on the New York Times Best Seller List at #7 and at #8 on Publishers Weekly Bestseller List.

item.title: HarperCollins Christian Publishing Announces Major Five-Book Deal with 'In Totality' Podcast Host Megan Ashley - HarperCollins Christian Publishing
item.description: HarperCollins Christian Publishing is pleased to announce the signing of Megan Ashley, the dynamic host of the fast-growing podcast In Totality, under a significant five-book agreement. The deal includes two trade books with Nelson Books, two curriculum projects with HarperCollins Resources, and one devotional.
